blast.diversity.tip: Designed for mixed environmental samples and multi-replicate sequencing to classify single reads and remove 16S copy-number bias.
blast.diversity.drop: Drop sequencing delivery archive (ZIP) or FASTQ reads
assembly.sidebar.title: Assembly History
assembly.setup.title: Genome Assembly Setup (NGCS Engine)
assembly.setup.subtitle: High-fidelity de novo assembly powered by NGCS for short-read Illumina/MGI, long-read Nanopore/PacBio HiFi, and hybrid workflows.
assembly.setup.drop_desc: Supports paired-end FASTQ (R1/R2), long-read FASTQ (.fq.gz, .fastq), hybrid reads, and ZIP sequencing archives (.zip)
assembly.setup.enable_qc: Enable Fastp automatic adapter trimming and quality filtering
assembly.setup.busy_hint: Engine is currently busy; new tasks will be added to the serial queue
assembly.results.open_folder_title: Reveal output directory in file manager
assembly.results.col.name: Contig Name
analysis.hub.title: Post-Assembly Analysis Workbench
analysis.hub.subtitle: Comprehensive genome annotation and comparative genomics workspace supporting structural/functional annotation, prophage boundary mining, pan-genomics, Sanger mutation calling, and genome maps.
analysis.tool.sanger_trace.title: Sanger Trace & Mutation Analysis
analysis.tool.sanger_trace.desc: Parse AB1 chromatogram fluorescence signals to call SNVs and overlapping InDel shift peaks with dual-haplotype deconvolution.
analysis.tool.annotation.title: Whole-Genome Structural & Functional Annotation
analysis.tool.annotation.desc: Predict and annotate CDS, tRNA, and rRNA via Prokka and Pharokka pipelines with standard GenBank/GFF3 exports and interactive viewer linkage.
analysis.tool.phage_discovery.title: Prophage & Phage Intelligent Discovery
analysis.tool.phage_discovery.desc: Segment prophage regions from host genomes or contigs with Stage 1.2 and 200bp SubBinRefiner boundary refinement plus optional protein gating.
analysis.tool.phage_structure.title: Phage Structure & Tail Morphotype Prediction
analysis.tool.phage_structure.desc: Classify Myo/Sipho/Podo/Non-tailed morphotypes via TSP, MTP, TAP, TTPA/B, and Virfam connector modules with quantitative TMP molecular ruler analysis.
analysis.tool.pan_genomics.title: Multi-Sample Pan-Genomics Analysis
analysis.tool.pan_genomics.desc: Build core and accessory gene families via orthologous clustering to analyze gene gain/loss, receptor diversity, and therapeutic safety.
analysis.tool.viewer.title: Genome Sequence & Feature Map Viewer
analysis.tool.viewer.desc: Interactive circular and linear genome feature browser supporting GenBank and GFF3 annotation tracks.
studio.hub.title: Figure Studio
studio.hub.subtitle: Publication-grade figure suite aligned with Nature Microbiology, Nature Communications, and NAR standards, directly reusing local annotation and phylogeny outputs.
studio.hub.tool_subtitle_suffix: Supports publication-ready vector PDF / SVG and high-DPI PNG exports with live zoom preview
studio.tool.phylo_tree.title: Phylogenetic Tree & Multi-Ring Publication Layout
studio.tool.phylo_tree.desc: End-to-end TerL and proteome phylogeny pipeline supporting circular, half-circular, composite (a+b), and rectangular multi-track vector rendering.
studio.tool.viridic_heatmap.title: VIRIDIC Intergenomic Similarity & ANI Matrix
studio.tool.viridic_heatmap.desc: Generate ICTV-standard dual-triangle similarity heatmaps (upper similarity + lower aligned fraction + top length bars) and tree-linked ANI matrices.
studio.tool.genome_map.title: Single-Genome Circular & Multi-Track Map
studio.tool.genome_map.desc: Load completed Pharokka/Prokka tasks or GBK files to render publication Figure 1 circular maps with strand CDS, PHROG colors, GC content, and GC skew.
studio.tool.synteny_ribbon.title: Comparative Genome Synteny Ribbon Map
studio.tool.synteny_ribbon.desc: Built-in multi-threaded protein alignment supporting LoVis4u denoised highlights and clinker Bezier ribbons to expose tail-fiber shifts and defense islands.
studio.tool.diversity_window.title: Intra-Species Nucleotide Diversity (Pi) Hotspot Map
studio.tool.diversity_window.desc: Highlight micro-evolutionary divergence across closely related isolates with sliding-window Pi curves and per-gene hotspot heatmaps.
studio.tool.gene_network.title: Protein Sharing Network & Waffle Composition
studio.tool.gene_network.desc: Force-directed gene-sharing network revealing horizontal gene transfer and mosaicism with gridded small clusters and 10x10 category waffle charts.
studio.tool.host_matrix.title: Dual-Tree Host Range & Specificity Matrix
studio.tool.host_matrix.desc: Host-tree and phage-tree linked heatmaps plus diagonalized serotype/depolymerase/lysis matrices for phage therapy cocktail formulation.
strain.toolbar.shortcuts_hint: Ctrl+N: New Freezer | Ctrl+I: Batch Import | Ctrl+H: Help
other.hub.title: Automation Pipelines
other.hub.subtitle: Automated email annotation delivery and Sangon 16S BLAST batch workflows.
other.tool.mail_pipeline.title: Auto Mail Fetch -> Annotation -> Word Report -> SMTP Return
other.tool.mail_pipeline.desc: Fetch FASTA attachments via IMAP, run genome annotation and Word report generation, package outputs, and reply via SMTP.
other.tool.sangon_16s.title: Sangon 16S Sequencing Auto-BLAST & CSV Export
other.tool.sangon_16s.desc: Scan Sangon notification emails, build order folders, extract *.1.fasta sequences for 16S BLAST alignment, and export summary CSVs.
